messages:
Sam: Okay real question: who wakes up at 11:30pm to add a FAAB target? guilty. :coffee:
Lina: Me. Also guilty of yelling at the TV when the refs forget what rules are.
Marcus: Nets vs Knicks going OT?? wild. I thought this was supposed to be a chill Tuesday.
Dee: Turner hit that corner three and my heart stopped. Also my fantasy streamer delivered 18 points in 6 minutes lol
Oliver: Is anyone else salty about the league's waiver priority? I had first and somehow ended up with the worst sleeper.
Sam: @Oliver you submitted a blind bid of 0.5? that's why. :grimacing:
Lina: trade idea: Marcus -> my bench flyer + next week's priority for your guard help?
Marcus: depends who the guard is. send names.
Dee: waiver-bot: "waiver-bot: Sam claimed Malik for 5 FAAB. Current FAAB: Sam 12.3, Lina 7.0, Marcus 0.0"
Oliver: Wait what, Malik? He was on my radar. 
Sam: sorry not sorry, he lit it up tonight.
Lina: poll: who wins the playoff opener if these teams meet? React: 7E2 Celtics / 7E1 Bucks / 534 Heat / 535 Other
Marcus: 534 Heat, watch the defense late.
Oliver: 7E2 Celtics, but it's a toss-up.
Dee: 535 Other - always love the underdog narrative.
Sam: Also, quick logistics: can we change the waiver cutoff back to 10pm? midnight lock is a personal attack.
waiver-bot: "waiver-bot: League settings updated: roster lock moved to 10pm for next matchup (pending commish approval)."
Lina: bless you, waiver-bot.
Marcus: If commish approves, I will forgive all past transgressions.
Oliver: GIF: tiny dog celebrating (link)
Dee: End thread: anyone want to swap streaming tips? My bench is chaotic but sometimes gold. DM me.
Sam: DM sent. Good night, my FAAB is safe for now. :zzz:
